original.target_description: Experiment 2, explicit paper-and-pencil evaluations of the positively versus negatively conditioned Pokemon; subsequent t test, distinct from the implicit IAT t test and omnibus ANOVA.

n.sample_role: Participants contributing paired explicit evaluations; exact critical-test analytic count unresolved.
n.exclusions: Six of 56 participants were excluded from all analyses for mentioning a CS-US contingency. The resulting overall candidate count is 50, but the explicit t test is printed with 48 degrees of freedom; no test-specific final N or further exclusion is stated.
n.quote: On the final item of the postexperimental questionnaire, 6 of the 56 ... To be conservative, we excluded the data from ... these 6 participants from all analyses, although this omission had no ... effect on the statistical significance of the results.

es.location: p. 416 (source page 4), Experiment 2, Results, right column, subsequent t tests

p.location: p. 416 (source page 4), Experiment 2, Results, right column, same explicit t test

notes: Identity independently checked: title IMPLICIT ATTITUDE FORMATION THROUGH CLASSICAL CONDITIONING, authors Michael A. Olson and Russell H. Fazio, Psychological Science volume 12 issue 5 September 2001, pages 413–417, match the neutral original reference. The canonical header supplies DOI 10.1111/1467-9280.00376 and an Ohio State hosted article PDF URL. This is a full primary journal-article text with both experiments and references, not an abstract or secondary report. No PDF path is supplied, so rendering was unavailable within the permitted inputs. Canonical text encodes equals as U+0004, plus as U+0002, minus as U+0003 and less-than as U+0005; evidence quotes retain these literal characters. The explicit paper-and-pencil clause independently identifies the target. Its t(48) = 1.92 and p = .03 are retained without conversion; the omnibus F(1, 46) = 6.45, p = .015 and implicit t(48) = 2.59, p = .007 are different tests. N candidate arithmetic: 56 recruited - 6 excluded = 50 overall retained participants, not an accepted critical-test analytic N. The printed explicit t(48) creates an unresolved inconsistency; N was not inferred from df. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
